title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Paid-Up Window of the Replacing HomeFlood Policy
content:
## Paid-up window

Applies to a cancellation request under NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) signed under Replaced by Private Flood because a Tidemark HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies policy recorded as replacing this policy took effect.

The paid-up window is measured from the latest premium payment on the replacing HomeFlood policy, as its premium ledger shows it, to the signing date, and its length follows the HomeFlood policy's payment plan:

| Replacing policy's payment plan | Window |
|---|---|
| Annual | 365 days |
| Semi-annual | 183 days |
| Quarterly | 92 days |
| Any other | No days |

When the latest payment came longer before the signing date than the window allows — or no payment is on the replacing policy's ledger — the request may be dated no earlier than the signing date.

*Hypothetical cases.* A quarterly-plan HomeFlood policy last paid 92 days before signing is within the window; last paid 93 days before, it is not. An annual-plan policy last paid 200 days before signing is within its 365-day window.
